newsitem.title: USA: Dow revisits day's lows, NYSE reimposes curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow revisits day's lows, NYSE reimposes curbs.

text.p: The Dow industrials revisited session lows, prompting the NYSE to reimpose curbs on index-arbitrage orders at 1521 EST/2021 GMT.
The Dow lost 52 to 6351. The Nasdaq Composite lost three to 1306.
Losers beat gainers 14-9 on very heavy NYSE volume of 439 million shares.
"It's a continuation from yesterday. The same kind of action," said Jay Meagrow, an institutional trader at McDonald & Co.
"This market is skittish and plenty of people are long. I don't know if we're headed for a major break but we'll have a couple more days like this between now and the end of the year," he added.
The long bond fell 2/32 to yield 6.63 percent.
